mechanisms: One shared id, one frame: the same-tick id race split a shared id over two sites and raised a second, unwanted frame four times (t2 #vp2 corvp_2012, t3 #avp1 armavp_6196, t3 #ap1 armap_30335, t4 #vp3 corvp_4612; 1738 metal), and twice the player's remove of the duplicate never ran: the 'stop','assist' list beside it turned the reclaimer into a helper (armavp_6196) and a 'stop' in the same turn cancelled the list that held the reclaim (armap_30335). The race is the one fixed after this game (2026-10-12, unmeasured); a remove that survives a same-turn 'stop' and never becomes a help step would have taken back most of armavp_6196's 1040 too.

One frame at a time on an empty metal store: t3's three Overwatch towers, the moho and the def_west tower (armhlt_28022, armhlt_20798, armhlt_7003, armmoho_12300) stood 1.5-2.5 min at metal 0 with eleven constructors spread over them, two plants and the Starlights, and t4's Twin Guard at spot_15 (corhllt_28232) and t2's nano and H3 Guard did the same; finishing them in turn before the Bulls and the corgator raid arrived would have kept up to 1411 metal (the last-minute 'stop' at 26:59 was the player's sound call once the Bulls stood in the base cell).

No frame under a raid that is already there: a list step started, and the hands kept the builder on, frames with a raider standing at the spot or a raid party or Shiva within 600 (t2's H4 extractors beside a sitting Rascal and the F4 Guard with 7 corgator 385 away, t3's spot_162 re-sent three times into 4 Rovers, t4's F2/H1 turrets and the H2/H3/G4 Guards under out-of-sight Shiva fire); holding the step until the spot is clear would have kept about 572 metal. Six frames that out-of-sight fire killed (t2 corvp_2012, corsolar_21511, corwin_18135; t4 corllt_23182, corllt_21323, corllt_640) were reported 'abandoned ... its builder was sent elsewhere and the frame decayed', so the report gave the players the wrong cause.
unread: nothing torn or skipped; all three seats read (seats 1 and 2 through symlink directories for hands_window and floor). frames.py measures a never-started order from the command's site, not the placed site: 21 of the 147 were placed more than 300 from the command, 17 were then begun by the same builder within 150 s, and 86 saw a frame of that type rise at the site within 150 s (mostly an id's helpers, e.g. t2's four coravp #avp1 orders, placed 595 away and built as plant_13514); the read covers the rest, the costliest fifteen a seat. frames.py's decayed fate is any frame destroyed by nobody: 6 of the 24 so labelled were killed outright by fire from out of sight (corvp_2012, corsolar_21511, corwin_18135, corllt_23182, corllt_21323, corllt_640) and 2 more took a last shot after decaying (armllt_12363, armavp_6196); the fate is kept as frames.py gives it and the cause says what happened. floor.py aband 7/14/3 equals the decayed counts per seat.
